description: KAPSARC Regional Electricity Demand Model (KREDM) KREDM is a model or code deposit deposited in angz.vftgfr by its authors Jeyhun Mikayilov. Coverage: national (SA); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
